w4-m3-webhook-proxy-cors.explanation: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing controls whether browser JavaScript may read a cross-origin response through response headers and preflight behavior. w4-m5-retry-idempotency.answer: A timeout does not prove no side effect; retry-safe writes reuse a stable idempotency key that Backend enforces.
w4-m5-retry-idempotency.explanation: Retries trade transient-failure recovery against duplicate side effects. Idempotency keys bind multiple delivery attempts to one logical operation, typically through server-side uniqueness/state. Timeouts are ambiguous outcomes; exponential backoff/jitter and explicit retry classification reduce load and synchronize recovery behavior.
